items.stem: AI summarises an alert as benign. What should the analyst do before closing it?

options.text: Verify the summary against the underlying logs and evidence
options.rationale: Correct: AI triage summaries must be confirmed against raw evidence before closure.

options.text: Close the alert immediately to reduce the queue
options.rationale: Closing on an unverified summary can miss a real incident.

options.text: Escalate every benign alert to management
options.rationale: Blanket escalation defeats the purpose of triage.

options.text: Delete the logs to save storage
options.rationale: Deleting evidence undermines investigation and custody.

items.explanation: Correct: AI triage summaries must be confirmed against raw evidence before closure.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO risks are specific to using AI on attacker-influenced content in a SOC? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Prompt injection hidden in ingested text manipulating the AI
options.rationale: Correct: adversaries can embed instructions that subvert AI output.

options.text: Sensitive incident data leaking into an uncontrolled tool
options.rationale: Correct: entering incident data into uncontrolled tools risks exposure.

options.text: Faster log summarisation for the analyst
options.rationale: Faster summarisation is a benefit, not a risk.
Searchable history is a benefit, not a risk.

items.explanation: Correct: adversaries can embed instructions that subvert AI output.

items.stem: Why should containment actions not be fully automated from AI output alone?

options.text: A wrong automated block can disrupt the business, so a human must confirm consequential actions
options.rationale: Correct: consequential containment needs human judgement to avoid false-positive harm.

options.text: AI can never help with containment
options.rationale: AI can assist; the point is human confirmation of consequential actions.

options.text: Automation is always faster and therefore always correct
Containment decisions have no business impact
options.rationale: Containment can have significant business impact.

items.explanation: Correct: consequential containment needs human judgement to avoid false-positive harm.
